elements.content:
Ben: Yesterday was Sunday. What were you doing

at this time yesterday?

Mary: I was playing soccer with my friends in the

park.

Ben: Who scored the most goals?

Mary: Bob did. He is really good at playing soccer.

Ben: Were you all having a good time?

Mary: Yes, we also flew kites and played hide-and-

seek together.

Ben: What a fun day!

elements.content:
Hello, hello, hello. Hi, hi, hi.

Good morning to you, good morning to you.

It’s a beautiful day, let’s go out and play.

Good afternoon to you, good afternoon to you.

It’s a nice day, let’s whistle a tune.

Good evening to you, good evening to you.

It’s wonderful night, let’s dance in the moonlight

child_list.content: 你那时在做什么？
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content:
本：昨天是星期天。昨天这个时候你在干

什么？

玛丽：我和朋友在公园里踢足球。

本：谁进的球最多？

玛丽：鲍勃进球最多。他真的很擅长踢足 球。

本：你们都玩得开心吗？

玛丽：是的，我们还一起放风筝，玩捉迷

藏。

本：多有趣的一天啊！

child_list.content: 你好，你好，你好
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content:
你好，你好，你好。嗨，嗨，嗨。

早上好，早上好。

美好的一天，我们出去玩吧。

下午好，下午好。

美好的一天，让我们吹口哨吧。

晚上好，晚上好。

美好的夜晚，让我们在月光下跳舞吧。
